VIM0 adds manifest files MF01-MF05, sections MS01-MS12, rules VM01-VM28, cell tiers CT0-CT4, current authorities G01-G09, outcomes VIM-O01-VIM-O05, consumers VIM-C01-VIM-C10, plan consumers VIM-P01-VIM-P03, displaced routes VIM-D01-VIM-D04, findings VIM-F01-VIM-F06 and transferred obligations VIM-T01-VIM-T04. A successor path for a route this node displaces starts at VIM0. TIF1 and IDX0 are not successors of VIM0, so VIM-D02 and VIM-D03 keep the controller path already recorded for that owner. VIM-D01 is NCK5 on VIM0 to VIM1 to NCK5. VIM-D04 is FCH1 on VIM0 to VIM1 to FCH1; VIM1 is a predecessor of FCH1.

layout.root: verticals/<vertical>/ for kind carrier; verticals/<vertical>/<release>/ for kind semantic-profile and project-profile
layout.rule: A carrier manifest is keyed by CarrierProfileId alone and has no ReleaseId (VID0 I03 neverContains ReleaseId). A semantic-profile manifest is keyed by FrameworkProfileId, derived from exactly one ReleaseId (VID0 I05); the directory release equals that ReleaseId. A project-profile manifest is keyed by ProjectProfileId, derived from exactly one ReleaseId (VID0 I07); the directory release equals that ReleaseId. A release directory is spelled with '.', '-' and '+' only (tracked_paths_are_portable). Two manifests for one carrier id, or two directory releases for one profile id, fail as CAT0 CR07. VIM1 creates the tree.

sectionRule: A section listed for a kind is mandatory. A section that does not apply is written not-applicable with a typed reason, never omitted (VM08). Each section renders a row an earlier decision owns and adds shape, never meaning.

cellKey: profile-qualified CapabilityId (CAT0 T07 row key; VID0 I10). Profile, carrier and release are inside that id and are not restated. The per-surface maturity value names each MS08 surface. Host identity is not a key (VID0 R14). A T09 extension is a separate row cited by id.
fullSupportRule: Full support of a release is derived: every required cell is CT4 on every published surface. It is never authored (VM21).

rules.rule: Every manifest file carries schema = ManifestSchemaEpoch; a schema change mints a new epoch.

A semantic-profile or project-profile manifest declares exactly one ReleaseId (VID0 R04), equal to the ReleaseId inside its profile id and to the directory name. A carrier manifest declares none (VID0 R04, I03, R02). A release key on a carrier, a versions array, range, latest/next tag, wildcard or complement is a structural failure. An unsupported version is DEM0's UnsupportedVersion outcome, never a cell. Two manifests for one carrier id, or two releases for one profile id, fail as CAT0 CR07.

Keys are typed identities in canonical tagged encoding (VID0 R12, R13). display_family, adapter spellings, FrameworkTag and extensions are presentation only (VID0 R03, CAT0 CR10). A cell does not restate the profile, carrier or release its CapabilityId already carries.
kind decides the identity of id. A project-profile manifest declares no carrier, parser or compiler; a carrier manifest declares no semantic facet and no ReleaseId.

Carrier geometry is the CarrierProfileId axis (VID0 I03): dedicated-carrier, script-carrier, neutral-carrier, embedded-syntax, document-language or dsl, and that manifest is its only authority. A semantic profile does not restate it: geometry is the claim shape overlay or attachment, or not-applicable with reason carrier-owned. A project profile's geometry is project-overlay only (VID0 I07 carries no carrier geometry). A profile geometry in a carrier class, a carrier geometry of overlay, attachment or project-overlay, or a profile geometry equal to a claimed carrier's geometry fails (MN17).
Every owner, producer, deletion and acceptance reference names an existing plan node and acceptance ID; prose, retired block names and people are not owners.
claims reference existing manifests by typed id; a dangling claim fails as CAT0 CR07.
Closed schema: unknown keys, extra/ext/x-*/metadata bags, untyped maps and free-form tables fail. The only extension point is a typed T09 contribution row (CAT0 CR04).

[parser] and [compiler] share no key. A parser entry naming a backend or compile capability, a compiler entry naming a grammar or ParserId, or compile capability inferred from a parser is conflation (UAK1 U03). DK5 is kind no-parser with no frontend.
[activation] stage-one fact kinds are parse-domain only (DEM0 DR07); the activation source is FWA1's record and a second source fails.
Every embedding names a map-chain kind [[map]] defines; every map names ENC0 coordinate kinds at both ends.
Every published facet has one typeinfo_role row; a derived row names its derivation kind.
[custom_elements] has exactly one producer and one consumer row, each a CEF0 disposition or not-applicable with a typed reason. A missing row fails and is never read as no custom elements.
Every peer that can claim one of the manifest's carriers has a [[coexistence]] row, or the overlap is a typed ambiguity (CAT0 CR14, DEM0 DR22). Two relations for one peer fail (CR07).
Every listed surface uses the PUB0 outcome vocabulary; a registered handler with no implemented cell is a boolean capability lie (UAK1 U07).
A budget is a reference to a ratified row by id. A manifest-declared threshold, a self-picked gate or an omitted gate a required cell needs is a self-selected performance gate.
[compiler] = none is normal (UAK1 U02). A backend on a carrier names the FrameworkProfileId it serves; the release is that id's ReleaseId, and the carrier gains no release key.
Every [[deletion]] names an earlier-recorded route id, one owner node and its receiving acceptance.
[[forbidden_dependency]] restates UAK1 firewall edges; the firewall stays UAM0's.
A cell is data: tier, producer node, receiving acceptance and evidence ids. A note-only row is a prose-only capability row; notes never carry meaning.

The required capability list is normative per schema epoch, kind and geometry. One cell per required profile-qualified CapabilityId (CAT0 T07). Its per-surface maturity value names every MS08 surface, one tier each. A manifest cannot drop a required cell, omit a published surface, exclude a surface without an admitted reason, or declare full support while any required maturity is below CT4. Two maturity entries for one surface fail. Host identity is not a key (VID0 R14). A T09 row is cited by id and is not part of the cell key.
rules/*.toml rows are CAT0 T08 rows in LRA0's vocabulary.

oracles.lock pins are exact with integrity digests. On a semantic-profile or project-profile manifest, release and the oracle pin that defines it agree. A carrier manifest has no release to compare. A cell cites no separate compatibility release. An oracle is never a dependency or an authority (PAR0 PD04).
Every fixture has a content digest and an executing acceptance.

Tier promotion follows evidence: CT2 is WDX0 static-proof, CT3 is executed public-boundary tests named by test id and has no WDX0 class, CT4 is runtime-observation from the vertical's own terminal (WDX0 claim laws). A geometry proof, installed parser, syntax highlighting or upstream install never promotes above CT2.

Manifests are the authority for facts a vertical declares. Rendering does not transfer row ownership: T01-T03 stay CPF1 (CPF1-AC2), T04 stays PPR0T (PPR0T-AC1), T05 stays EMB0I (EMB0I-AC1), T06 and T07 stay COX0 (COX0-AC2), T08 stays LNT3 (LNT3-AC2), T09 stays XSDK1 (XSDK1-AC1), and PD01 stays PAR0. VIM1 renders into those rows. The capability matrix, TS mirrors, docs support tables, the compile capability table and per-family matrices are rendered consumers; a hand edit fails freshness and a second hand-maintained truth fails.

Manifests are data: no script, expression, regex, template, code path, hook or plugin reference; loading executes nothing. Tables are ordered by canonical key encoding; two clean renders are byte-identical.

A project profile has one ProjectProfileId per exact release; incompatible majors (Tailwind v3, v4) are separate manifests. A migration names source and target ProjectProfileIds and never mints a merged identity; both active in one scope is DEM0's typed ambiguity. A geometry that cannot be written under VM01-VM28 rescopes the schema by amendment, never by an untyped escape.

findings.finding: capability-matrix.tsv names core@3.6.0-rc.3 and svelte@5.56.8 while the oracle package.json files pin vue 3.6.0-rc.5 and svelte 5.56.10. VM23 makes the oracle pin the release and fails the divergence (MN15). FCH1 owns the TSV; VIM1 cannot write that path.

VueOtherVersion and SvelteOtherVersion encode a version complement as a capability cell. Under VM02 that is DEM0's UnsupportedVersion activation outcome. NCK5 deletes the arms with CapabilityCell; VIM1 rejects the complement as MN01.
The matrix owner and acceptance_id columns name retired blocks (B2, BV1, FC-...). Migration into MF02 rebinds each row to a plan node and acceptance ID (VM06).

VIM1 domains are area:verticals, area:xtask, shared:ci-workflow and area:.github, and CPF1 precedes VIM1, so neither can delete CapabilityCell after the freshness guard. VIM-D01 binds that deletion to NCK5 (NCK5-AC1), whose charter path crates/verter_compiler contains the file and who follows VIM1. VIM-D04 binds the harness TSV to FCH1 (FCH1-AC3).
tag_disposition marks React and Solid OutOfScope while the plan carries React and Solid verticals. V-D03 retags the table; a manifest's existence decides a tag's disposition.

Family delivery locks (for example ANG0 products/angular-capability-matrix.json) each plan a family-local capability matrix. Under VM26 it seeds that family's first manifest and is then a rendered consumer, never a co-authority.
